attestations.text: CHU I-kuei 朱一貴, d.c.1721, desperado, was a native of Ch'ang-t'ai, Fukien. Compelled to leave his native place, he went to Taiwan (Formosa) in 1713 as a servant to the intendant of the Circuit of Taiwan and Hsia-mên (Amoy).
